title: Wing Leading Edge Harnesses — Front Spar Route and Tank Access Panel Crossings
abstract: Wiring diagram sheet for the wing leading edge harnesses, showing the front spar route, the slat area branches and the crossings over the wing tank access panel line.

sections.purpose: This sheet shows the wing leading edge harnesses, the front spar route, the slat area branches and the connector positions, for all ZEPHYR-22 family aircraft.
sections.sheet_note: The sheet is drawn for the left wing; the right wing is a mirror image with the same harness references. The route crosses the tank access panel line at four stations, and those crossings are called out separately on the sheet because the harness support at each of them is attached to the panel land and is disturbed whenever the panel is removed. Anti-icing circuits and sensing circuits are carried in separate bundles and the separation between them is stated at each branch point.
sections.routing_note: The harness leaves the wing root penetration and runs outboard along the front spar through zones 593 and 551 to the slat area branch points, then forward into the fixed leading edge. Support brackets on the tank access panel land must be transferred to the replacement panel when a panel is exchanged; a harness supported on a panel that has been removed and not re-supported will chafe against the panel edge within a few hundred cycles.
